description: In the default AlwaysVisible mode, the dock remains fully shown after the pointer moves onto an icon, moves away, and leaves the dock window.

assertions.comment: Before I move the pointer away, the hovered dock reports that my pointer is inside the panel.
Before I move the pointer away, I see the AlwaysVisible panel fully opaque.
Before I move the pointer away, I see the bottom panel fully shown at y=36.

After I move away and leave the dock window, the panel reports that my pointer is outside. Marked invariant: AlwaysVisible means the leave must change nothing. The discriminator is dock-visibility-autohide, where the same leave slides the same panel off screen.

After I move away and leave the dock window, I still see the AlwaysVisible panel fully opaque. Marked invariant: AlwaysVisible means the leave must change nothing. The discriminator is dock-visibility-autohide, where the same leave slides the same panel off screen.

After I move away and leave the dock window, I still see the bottom panel fully shown at y=36. Marked invariant: AlwaysVisible means the leave must change nothing. The discriminator is dock-visibility-autohide, where the same leave slides the same panel off screen.

After my pointer leaves, I still see the AlwaysVisible dock window mapped at its full 1024x108 size. Marked invariant: AlwaysVisible means the leave must change nothing. The discriminator is dock-visibility-autohide, where the same leave slides the same panel off screen.
